generate_architects_doc: run the script to auto generate the architects.md documentation file from registered architect types
run_main: run the main function to generate markdown docs for all valid mephisto architect types
review_main: review the main function that iterates over architect types and generates documentation using MdUtils
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support a custom output path for the generated architects markdown file
summarize_main: summarize the main function that uses get_valid_architect_types and get_wut_arguments to build architect docs
